_comment: ALL brand values live here. Edit, then run `python3 build.py --check`. Renaming the product = change `name` (and `domain`/`contactEmail` if they change too). Never type the product name into src/: use {{name}}. `--check` fails if the name appears literally in src/ or public/assets/. Values may contain {{tokens}} (e.g. {{name}}).
name: Warden
_siteUrl: Derived as https://<domain>. Set `siteUrl` explicitly only if the site lives somewhere else.
tagline: A local checkpoint for AI coding agents.
description: {{name}} is a free, open-source (MIT) macOS menu-bar app that checks what AI coding agents are about to do. It blocks secret reads, destructive commands and data exfiltration, asks you about the grey areas, and keeps a local log. No account, nothing uploaded.
_download: downloadUrl is derived as /download/<name>.dmg. --check tolerates that one path being missing until the real .dmg is copied into public/download/.
requirements: macOS 14 or later · Apple silicon & Intel
signing: Signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
_repo: repoUrl is the public source repository; releasesUrl/securityUrl/issuesUrl are derived from it in build.py.

accent._comment: Warden teal, taken from the app's own primary button. light/onLight are used on the light theme, dark/onDark on the dark theme. Verdict colours (allowed/blocked/ask) are separate and live in styles.css.

pricing._comment: The app is free and open source under the MIT License. `headline` is the short phrase used in copy ("{{name}} is {{pricing.headline}}"). plans[] feed the JSON-LD offer (price 0). cta.type: download | mailto | link.
pricing.headline: free and open source (MIT)
pricing.note: The app is free and open source: full local protection, no account, no license key.

plans.name: Free
plans.blurb: Everything the app does, on your Mac. No sign-up, no card, no paid tier. The source is on GitHub.
features: All supported agents: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Cline
Allow, ask, observe and block decisions
Built-in rules for secrets, destructive commands and exfiltration
Searchable local activity log, secrets masked

testimonials._comment: Only REAL quotes, with permission. Each item: {quote, name, role, url}. While the list is empty the site shows an invitation to beta testers instead.
